- Vim (version: ) behaves differently?
Never used any sort of terminal solution in Vim

- Operating system/version:
OSX El Capitan 10.11.6 (15G1217)

- Terminal name/version:
Iterm2 Build 3.0.14

- `$TERM`:
fish, version 2.3.1

### Actual behaviour
Segfault when I have the terminal open in a split and I switch to/from that window or resize that window. Seems to only happen after running for a while like over an hour.

### Steps to reproduce using `nvim -u NORC`

Not sure, but I will try working in `nvim -u NORC` for a couple days and see what happens
